sloka: प्रचेतसो ऽहं दशमः पुत्रो राघवनन्दन ।न स्मराम्यनृतं वाक्यमिमौ तु तव पुत्रकौ ।। ७.९६.१९ ॥
transliteration: pracetaso 'haṁ daśamaḥ putro rāghavanandana ।na smarāmyanṛtaṁ vākyamimau tu tava putrakau ।। 7.96.19 ॥

translations.english: O delight of the Raghus, I am the tenth son of Prachetas, and I have never uttered a lie; these two are indeed your sons.
